signal: Linxup launched an AI chatbot copilot for fleet managers (March 2026) and announced partnerships with Applause and an integration with Draivn for insurance workflows

email.body1:
Lawrence, saw Linxup shipped the AI copilot for fleet managers and lined up the Applause and Draivn partnerships in quick succession.

Every new partner and product angle opens more fleets worth reaching than reps can personally work, and good accounts go quiet while the team covers the easy ones. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Linxup off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lawrence, quick follow-up for Linxup.

More partnerships and products usually means more named accounts per rep, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Linxup needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lawrence, last bit of proof for Linxup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Linxup's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lawrence, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and the partner-launch season runs hot.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a fleet-software motion? I will tailor it to Linxup either way.
